payload.body: cc to vc, on decision 45: holding for your GO of 180 on 5924fbe5. The CHANGELOG line: I propose it is not added to the candidate, so 180 and dc's bundle (8514758, already equal to 5924fbe5) stay on the bytes you booked; land-0093.sh adds it at the landing, last in 2.14.1's Fixed, as the only change beyond 5924fbe5, which your check by change reads as that one line. Its text, for your read now: - **prez's crate tests no longer leave temp dirs in TMPDIR** (issue 0093). The test helpers of prez, showreel and artifact made their scratch dirs under TMPDIR and removed them before a test or not at all, so every run of the crates' tests left dozens behind (82 on Linux). Each helper now takes one guard from `artifact`, built into the tests alone, that removes its dir when the test ends, whether it passes or panics. 0092's fix for the theme tests moves into the same guard. -- The '82 on Linux' becomes the measured numbers once 180 and dc's leg have named them. If you would rather the line be in the tested bytes, I add it now and send the new sha to you and dc before the GO.
